text:
maya: 2026-03-18 10:10 PDT - started nccl 3.4.0 canary on spot pool (us-west2). Seeing socket timeouts and hangs on 8x A100 infer jobs, tail latency exploded.

maya: sample nccl log:
```
[2026-03-18 10:11:02] NET/Socket : Timeout waiting for peer connect (socket 12)
[2026-03-18 10:11:03] NCCL INFO CAL: AllGather timeout on rank 3
```

jonathan: how many nodes? severity?

katie: ~25 canary spot nodes, ~60% of 8-gpu jobs fail to complete, 1-2 minute stalls, CPU repro low. non-spot reserved nodes are fine.

li: logs show frequent TCP retransmits and connect failures between p2p ports. can you grab `ss -tin` and `dmesg` from a failed host?

maya: pasted ss output and dmesg in thread. dmesg shows "mlx5_core: CQ overflow" on some hosts, but NVLink counters look normal.

ops-bot: alert: collective-failure-rate us-west2=62% over 10m; triggered paging to @sre-oncall

sre-oncall: acknowledged. rolling canary -> hold. can we hotfix with env flags before rollback? try forcing TCP iface and disabling p2p.

li: quick mitigations to try (non-invasive):
```
export NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=eth0
export NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=SYS  # force system-level copies
export NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1    # disable ibverbs
```
These cut perf but may stop hangs.

maya: applied NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=eth0 on 25 canary hosts, failures dropped to ~8% immediately. staging tests show degraded throughput ~20% but stable.

deploy-bot: rollback initiated for us-west2 canary -> nccl 3.3.3 (job id 3456). ETA 7m :hourglass:

jonathan: open a bisection matrix job between 3.3.3 and 3.4.0 with varying driver/kernel combos, include mlx5 firmware patches.

katie: created infra ticket INF-1722 with logs, assigned to eng-infra + eng-runtime. Filing support case with NVIDIA, attaching cc logs.

maya: action items: hold nccl 3.4.0 until driver/firmware matrix validated; run kernel+mlx5 firmware upgrade in staging; add tcp/backoff metrics to console; postmortem after rollback completes. I'll update incident board.

sre-oncall: thanks — closing oncall until rollback green, will follow up with runbook update.
